description.p: URDF Description package for the Unitree Go2 quadruped.

VENDORED THIRD-PARTY PACKAGE — see README.md in this directory for provenance, the mesh hash verification against unitree_ros, and the exact list of edits made on top of upstream. Meshes are byte-identical to unitreerobotics/unitree_ros; the xacro layer is a ROS 2 port from legubiao/quadruped_ros2_control.
